text_en: Now when Jesus learned that the Pharisees had heard, “Jesus is making and baptizing more disciples than John”
text_cn: 耶稣一知道法利塞人听说他已收徒，施洗比若翰还多──

text_en: —although it was not Jesus himself but his disciples who baptized—
text_cn: 其实耶稣本人并没有施洗，而是他的门徒──

text_en: he left Judea and started back to Galilee.
text_cn: 便离开犹太，又往加里肋亚去了。

text_en: But he had to go through Samaria.
text_cn: 他必须途经撒玛黎雅。

text_en: So he came to a Samaritan city called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
text_cn: 于是到了撒玛黎雅的一座城，名叫息哈尔，靠近雅各伯给他儿子若瑟的庄田，

text_en: Jacob’s well was there, and Jesus, tired out by his journey, was sitting by the well. It was about noon.
text_cn: 在那里有“雅各伯泉”。耶稣因行路疲倦，就顺便坐在泉傍；那时，大约是第六时辰。

text_en: A Samaritan woman came to draw water, and Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink. ”
text_cn: 有一个撒玛黎雅妇人来汲水，耶稣向她说：“请给我点水喝！”

text_en: (His disciples had gone to the city to buy food. )
text_cn: 那时，他的门徒已往城里买食物去了。

text_en: The Samaritan woman said to him, “How is it that you, a Jew, ask a drink of me, a woman of Samaria? ” (Jews do not share things in common with Samaritans. )
text_cn: 那撒玛黎雅妇人就回答说：“你既是个犹太人，怎么向我一个撒玛黎雅妇人要水喝呢？”原来，犹太人和撒玛黎雅人不相往来。

text_en: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is that is saying to you, ‘Give me a drink, ’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答她说：“若是你知道天主的恩赐，并知道向你说：给我水喝的人是谁，你或许早求了他，而他也早赐给了你活水。”

text_en: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have no bucket, and the well is deep. Where do you get that living water?
text_cn: 那妇人问说：“先生，你连汲水器也没有，而井又深，你从哪里得那活水呢？

text_en: Are you greater than our ancestor Jacob, who gave us the well, and with his sons and his flocks drank from it? ”
text_cn: 难道你比我们的祖先雅各伯还大吗？他留给了我们这口井，他和他的子孙以及他的牲畜，都曾喝过这井里的水。”

text_en: Jesus said to her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will be thirsty again,
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“凡喝这水的，还要再渴；

text_en: but those who drink of the water that I will give them will never be thirsty. The water that I will give will become in them a spring of water gushing up to eternal life. ”
text_cn: 但谁若喝了我赐与他的水，他将永远不渴；并且我赐给他的水，将在他内成为涌到永生的水泉。”

text_en: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I may never be thirsty or have to keep coming here to draw water. ”
text_cn: 妇人说：“先生，请给我这水罢！免得我再渴，也免得我再来这里汲水。”

text_en: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come back. ”
text_cn: 耶稣向她说：“去，叫你的丈夫，再回这里来。”

text_en: The woman answered him, “I have no husband. ” Jesus said to her, “You are right in saying, ‘I have no husband’;
text_cn: 那妇人回答说：“我没有丈夫。”耶稣说：“你说：我没有丈夫，正对；

text_en: for you have had five husbands, and the one you have now is not your husband. What you have said is true! ”
text_cn: 因为你曾有过五个丈夫，而你现在所有的，也不是你的丈夫：你说的这话真对。”

text_en: The woman said to him, “Sir, I see that you are a prophet.
text_cn: 妇人向他说：“先生，我看你是个先知。

text_en: Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you say that the place where people must worship is in Jerusalem. ”
text_cn: 我们的祖先一向在这座山上朝拜天主，你们却说：应该朝拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。”

text_en: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“女人，你相信我罢！到了时候，你们将不在这座山，也不在耶路撒冷朝拜父。

text_en: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we know, for salvation is from the Jews.
text_cn: 你们朝拜你们所不认识的，我们朝拜我们所认识的，因为救恩是出自犹太人。

text_en: But the hour is coming, and is now here, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such as these to worship him.
text_cn: 然而时候要到，且现在就是，那些真正朝拜的人，将以心神以真理朝拜父，因为父就是寻找这样朝拜他的人。

text_en: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth. ”
text_cn: 天主是神，朝拜他的人，应当以心神以真理去朝拜他。”

text_en: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming” (who is called Christ). “When he comes, he will proclaim all things to us. ”
text_cn: 妇人说：“我知道默西亚──意即基督──要来，他一来了，必会告诉我们一切。”

text_en: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who is speaking to you. ”
text_cn: 耶稣向她说：“同你谈话的我就是。”

text_en: Just then his disciples came. They were astonished that he was speaking with a woman, but no one said, “What do you want? ” or, “Why are you speaking with her? ”
text_cn: 正在这时，他的门徒回来了，他们就惊奇他同一个妇人谈话；但是没有人问：“你要什么？”或：“你同她谈论什么？”

text_en: Then the woman left her water jar and went back to the city. She said to the people,
text_cn: 于是那妇人撇下自己的水罐，往城里去向人说：

text_en: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! He cannot be the Messiah, can he? ”
text_cn: “你们来看！有一个人说出了我所作过的一切事：莫非他就是默西亚吗？”

text_en: They left the city and were on their way to him.
text_cn: 众人从城里出来，往他那里去。

text_en: Meanwhile the disciples were urging him, “Rabbi, eat something. ”
text_cn: 这其间，门徒请求耶稣说：“辣彼，吃罢！”

text_en: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you do not know about. ”
text_cn: 他却回答说：“我已有食物吃，那是你们所不知道的。”

text_en: So the disciples said to one another, “Surely no one has brought him something to eat? ”
text_cn: 门徒便彼此问说：“难道有人给他送来了吃的吗？”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to complete his work.
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“我的食物就是承行派遣我者的旨意，完成他的工程。

text_en: Do you not say, ‘Four months more, then comes the harvest’? But I tell you, look around you, and see how the fields are ripe for harvesting.
text_cn: 你们不是说：还有四个月才到收获期吗？看，我给你们说：举起你们的眼，细看田地，庄稼已经发白，可以收割了。

text_en: The reaper is already receiving wages and is gathering fruit for eternal life, so that sower and reaper may rejoice together.
text_cn: 收割的人已领到工资，且为永生收集了果实，如此，撒种的和收割的将一同喜欢。

text_en: For here the saying holds true, ‘One sows and another reaps. ’
text_cn: 这正如俗语所说的：撒种的是一人，收割的是另一人。

text_en: I sent you to reap that for which you did not labor. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor. ”
text_cn: 我派遣你们在你们没有劳过力的地方去收割；别人劳了力，而你们去收获他们劳苦的成果。”

text_en: Many Samaritans from that city believed in him because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I have ever done. ”
text_cn: 城里有许多撒玛黎雅人信从了耶稣，因为那妇人作证说：“他向我说出了我所作过的一切。”

text_en: So when the Samaritans came to him, they asked him to stay with them; and he stayed there two days.
text_cn: 这样，那些撒玛黎雅人来到耶稣前，请求他在他们那里住下；耶稣就在那里住了两天。

text_en: And many more believed because of his word.
text_cn: 还有更多的人因着他的讲论，信从了他。

text_en: They said to the woman, “It is no longer because of what you said that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this is truly the Savior of the world. ”
text_cn: 他们向那妇人说：“现在我们信，不是为了你的话，而是因为我们亲自听见了，并知道他确实是世界的救主。”

text_en: When the two days were over, he went from that place to Galilee
text_cn: 过了两天，耶稣离开那里，往加里肋亚去了。

text_en: (for Jesus himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in the prophet’s own country).
text_cn: 耶稣曾亲自作证说：“先知在自己的家乡决受不到尊荣。”

text_en: When he came to Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him, since they had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the festival; for they too had gone to the festival.
text_cn: 他一来到加里肋亚，加里肋亚人便接待了他，因为他们也曾上了耶路撒冷去过节，并亲眼见了他在庆节中所行的一切。

text_en: Then he came again to Cana in Galilee where he had changed the water into wine. Now there was a royal official whose son lay ill in Capernaum.
text_cn: 耶稣又来到加里肋亚加纳，即他变水为酒的地方，那里有一位王臣，他的儿子在葛法翁患病。

text_en: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged him to come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
text_cn: 这人一听说耶稣从犹太到加里肋亚来了，就到他那里去，恳求他下来医治他的儿子，因为他快要死了。

text_en: Then Jesus said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders you will not believe. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“除非你们看到神迹和奇事，你们总是不信。”

text_en: The official said to him, “Sir, come down before my little boy dies. ”
text_cn: 那王臣向他说：“主，在我的小孩未死以前，请你下来罢！”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Go; your son will live. ” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him and started on his way.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“去罢！你的儿子活了。”那人信了耶稣向他所说的话，便走了。

text_en: As he was going down, his slaves met him and told him that his child was alive.
text_cn: 他正下去的时候，仆人们迎上他来，说他的孩子活了。

text_en: So he asked them the hour when he began to recover, and they said to him, “Yesterday at one in the afternoon the fever left him. ”
text_cn: 他问他们孩子病势好转的时刻，他们给他说：“昨天第七时辰，热就退了。”

text_en: The father realized that this was the hour when Jesus had said to him, “Your son will live. ” So he himself believed, along with his whole household.
text_cn: 父亲就知道正是耶稣向他说：“你的儿子活了”的那个时辰；他和他的全家便都信了。

text_en: Now this was the second sign that Jesus did after coming from Judea to Galilee.
text_cn: 这是耶稣从犹太回到加里肋亚后，所行的第二个神迹。
